title: Nchini Ufilipino, kukemea mtu mbele ya watu wengine ni mwiko

text.In the Philippines, scolding someone in: Nchini Ufilipino, kukemea mtu mbele ya watu wengine ni mwiko
text.When I was about to start working in the: Nilipokuwa karibu kuanza kufanya kazi Ufilipino, mafunzo yalikuwa na hadithi iliyonishtua.
text.In the Philippines, there is apparently: Nchini Ufilipino, inaonekana kuna utamaduni dhabiti, au tuseme mwiko, dhidi ya kukemea mtu mbele ya watu wengine.
text.Hurting the other person's pride is appa: Kuumiza kiburi cha mtu mwingine ni dhahiri ni jambo lisilofaa sana kufanya.
text.Learning that as a culture, as a Japanes: Kujifunza kwamba kama tamaduni, kama Mjapani, nilifikiri ulikuwa utamaduni mzuri kuwa nao.
text.And it's true, walking around in the Phi: Na ni kweli, nikitembea huku na huko Ufilipino, sijapata kuona watu wawili wakizomeana.
text.I never saw anyone blowing up at a shop: Sijawahi kuona mtu yeyote akilipua kwenye duka kwa ajili ya malalamiko, na kazini sikuwahi kuona mtu wa Ufilipino akikasirika sana pia.
text.In Japan, younger people don't seem to g: Huko Japani, vijana hawaonekani kukasirika hivyo, lakini wakati mwingine unaona wanaume wazee wa Kijapani wakikasirika katika sehemu kama vile mikahawa.
text.Staying calm with the person in front of: Kukaa mtulivu na mtu aliye mbele yako, bila kulipua, na kustahimili kila siku kwa mahusiano ya amani na yenye kujenga.
Nilidhani hilo lilikuwa jambo zuri sana.
